lines.en: I fly low through the woods.
My great mandibles lead the way.
My wings hum.
I thread between the trunks.
I land and lift off again.
My shadow sweeps the leaves.
I circle a big tree.
I come at you low.
My six legs are tucked in.
I head for the clearing.
I stop and hover.
I fly on.
My wing membranes are thin.
My shell catches the light.
I hover, wings still beating.

lines.zh: 我空咬两下，试试咬合力
lines.en: I bite empty air twice to test my grip.
I listen to the ground.

lines.zh: 我的复眼把你分成很多块
lines.en: My compound eyes split you into many pieces.
I rest under the canopy.
I turn slowly.
I hover and my wingbeat starts to fray.
I snap at the air.

lines.zh: 我压在一根细枝上歇翅
lines.en: I rest my wings on a thin twig.
The branch I'm perched on trembles.
I look up.
I take off again.
My call is coarse.

lines.zh: 我停在暗处，等林子安静
lines.en: I wait in the dark for the forest to settle.

lines.zh: 我原地转了个向，面对你
lines.en: I turn in place to face you.
You are a little bigger than me.

lines.zh: 我把颚分到最开给你看
lines.en: I open my mandibles as wide as they go for you.
Don't put a hand between my mandibles.

lines.zh: 你身上有火把和铁的味道
lines.en: You smell of torch smoke and iron.

lines.zh: 我在你帽子正上方悬着
lines.en: I hover right over your hat.
You have grown tall.

lines.zh: 别用那种眼神量我的甲
lines.en: Don't size up my armor with that look.

lines.zh: 我对着空气又夹了一下
lines.en: I snap my jaws once more at empty air.

lines.zh: 你一退，我的翅声就低了
lines.en: You retreat, and my wingbeat lowers.
That is better.
We need not fight.

lines.zh: 你手上的东西我看得见。
lines.en: I can see what you hold.

lines.zh: 我一点点缩小和你的距离
lines.en: I shave the distance between us bit by bit.
My wingbeat changes.
My wings quiet down.
I fly crooked for a moment.
My wingbeat falters.
I land on a tree.

lines.zh: 甲壳裂了条缝，嗡嗡声也哑了
lines.en: A crack splits my shell and my buzzing goes hoarse.
I beat my wings again.
My mandibles clack.

lines.zh: 甲上的印子，一会儿就凉了
lines.en: The dent in my shell will cool soon enough.

lines.zh: 翅还剩半边，我照样能升
lines.en: Half a wing left, and I can still climb.

lines.zh: 我贴在地上，眼睛还对着你
lines.en: I'm down on the ground, eyes still fixed on you.

lines.zh: 钳子还夹着，我会还回来。
lines.en: My pincers still clamp; I'll pay you back.
Is that an insect?
I smell it.
My jaws close and pin it in the middle.
It's not even worth one bite.
Only something that struggles suits my jaws.
Hold your hand steady; I hate the wavering.

lines.zh: 不是活物，我连碰都不碰
lines.en: Not alive — I won't even touch it.
One bite and it's gone; it fills no gap.

lines.zh: 这团东西被我一颚扫开
lines.en: One sweep of my jaw sends that lump flying.

lines.zh: 这东西我不吃，你拿回去
lines.en: I don't eat this; take it back.
I circle above it in the air.
I dip my head and sniff twice.
Your shoulder knocks against my wing membrane.

lines.zh: 被撞得横过来，我又扳回去
lines.en: The hit knocks me sideways and I correct again.

lines.zh: 甲壳撞你，响得像撞木头
lines.en: My shell hits you like it hit a log.

lines.zh: 撞完你倒退，我的翅没停
lines.en: After the crash you stumble back; my wings never stop.
My mandible grazes your shoulder.
My wingbeat falters.

lines.zh: 被撞落半尺，我又拉起来
lines.en: Knocked down half a foot, I pull back up.

lines.zh: 这一撞把你的力气传到我甲上
lines.en: The crash passes your force into my shell.
I settle back on a leaf.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我的颚就夹你
lines.en: One more bump and my jaws close on you.

lines.zh: 整片林子都有我的同类
lines.en: My kind are all over this forest.
They fly higher than I do.
We fight over the same tree.
My mandibles clash with its.
The sound is loud.
We pull apart.
Then clash again.
In the end we fly separate ways.

lines.zh: 刚才那下撞击还在枝叶间响
lines.en: That clash still rings through the leaves.
I return to the low branches.
I grip it in my mandibles.
This one is heavy; I fly lower.

lines.zh: 这块东西让我飞得歪歪的
lines.en: This load makes me fly lopsided.
It slips from my jaws.
I dive to pick it up again.
Hard and inedible — I drop it.
I can't lift it, so my jaws let go.
I'll carry this one off clamped in my mandibles.
I climb with it.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我的颚够得到
lines.en: What you dropped — my mandibles can reach it.
My mandibles line up with your nape.
My wingbeat sharpens.
I skim the grass tips toward you.
My mandibles open wide.
I am starting to chase.

lines.zh: 你这两条腿跑不过我翅
lines.en: Those two legs won't outrun my wings.
I fly faster than you.

lines.zh: 嗡嗡声绕到你背后去了
lines.en: The buzzing has slipped around behind you.
This bite will land.

lines.zh: 翅声一下拔高，我冲过来
lines.en: My wingbeat spikes and I charge in.
The trees will not stop me.

lines.zh: 我从树冠直直朝你压下
lines.en: I drop straight at you out of the canopy.
I follow you in the air.
I bank around the trunk.

lines.zh: 我的翅声就压在你头顶
lines.en: My buzzing presses down on the crown of your head.
I press down.
You look up again.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我的影子跟到哪
lines.en: Wherever you walk, my shadow follows.

lines.zh: 我从侧面切进你的视线
lines.en: I cut into your field of view from the side.

lines.zh: 你喘气的声音在树下很清楚
lines.en: Your breathing carries clearly under the tree.

lines.zh: 你靠到树干上，没路退了
lines.en: You've backed against the trunk with nowhere left.
A tree will not stop my mandibles.
I stop dead in the air, wings still beating.
I'm counting your steps to the tree.

lines.zh: 大颚一合，卡住你的肩甲
lines.en: My mandibles snap shut on your shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 我整个身子砸在你的胸口
lines.en: My whole body slams into your chest.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓住你的手臂。
lines.en: My legs grip your arm.
I drop in at an angle, mandibles first.

lines.zh: 你把我甩出去，我撞在树上
lines.en: You throw me off and I slam into a tree.
I climb again.
My mandibles close on nothing but air.
I lunge again.

lines.zh: 我的颚在你护甲上留了印
lines.en: My mandibles leave a mark on your armor.
My wings buzz by your ear.
I back off and hover.
You're still standing, so I'll dive again.
I drop out of the canopy.
My mandibles open for the first time.
A new hum joins the woods.
I settle on a branch.
My shell is harder than before.
I can fly now.
I try biting through a branch.
It snaps.
I look over the forest.
There is enough to eat here.
I take off.

lines.zh: 绕完一圈，我落到原来的枝上
lines.en: After one lap I land on the same branch.
I remember this big tree.
I patrol from this tree to that one.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的翅，我赶紧拍开。
lines.en: Fire catches my wing and I beat it out.

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下来，壳磕在地上。
lines.en: I fall from the tree and my shell hits the ground.

lines.zh: 水糊住我的翅，我挣不动。
lines.en: Water mats my wings and I cannot move them.
The blast slams me into a trunk.
An arrow pierces my wing membrane.

lines.zh: 咒光打过来，我的眼睛一花。
lines.en: Spell-light hits and my eyes swim.
There are fewer insects in these woods.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我从枝上掉下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I drop from the branch.
There are no trees to land on in the void.
